newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota hopes to announce India venture by July/Aug.
newsitem.headline: Toyota hopes to announce India venture by July/Aug.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday it hopes to announce a joint venture with India's Kirloskar group in July or August.
Toyota executive vice president Akira Yokoi told Reuters that Toyota would like to announce the agreement before starting its summer holidays in Japan on August 9.
"We are putting finishing touches to the details before making an application (to the Indian government for the joint venture)," he said in an interview.
In January, Toyota director Hideaki Otaka said the companies hoped to announce a final plan for the venture in the middle of 1997.
In February, a Kirloskar official said Toyota would hold a stake of more than 50 percent in the proposed project, in which the Japanese firm would invest between 30 billion yen and 50 billion yen.
Yokoi declined to say how much Toyota's investment would be. He said Bangalore was one of four possible sites for the venture. Kirloskar is based in Bangalore.
Toyota has said that the venture will probably produce multi-purpose or sports-utility vehicles.
Japan's Suzuki Motor Corp currently has a more than 70 percent share of India's passenger car market through a joint venture with the Indian government.
